Notion·https://www.notion.com**Notion** for Teams and Businesses Invite your team members and start getting organized. There's no time limit or credit card info, so you can try before you buy. Free. For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up. I

Notion itself is **free** to start with for personal use, and `paid plans are typically subscribed to directly through their platform rather than bought as a physical product`.

Here is how you can set up or upgrade your Notion account:

- **Free Plan:** Great for personal note-taking, task tracking, and basic page sharing. You can sign up directly on the [Notion Official Website](https://www.notion.com/).
- **Plus Plan (for power users):** Unlocks unlimited file uploads, unlimited block storage, and 30-day page history.
- **Business Plan:** Built for companies needing teamspaces, advanced permissions, and private team analytics.
- **Paid Templates & Bundles:** If you are looking for pre-built dashboards (like a *Second Brain* or *Starter Bundle* ), you can browse or buy creator systems directly via the [Notion Template Gallery](https://www.notion.com/templates/second-brain-virtual-office-life-work-system?srsltid=AYCX9vIiW2zETf0oLPAY5xnbJkShQ76NxjhHW2fZ_a-Iryc4UnaYKNBlXqk).
